section: S6 record edits and iPhone engine
title: Carry the engine's refusal reason on ApplyResult (with I-2's later steps, once the generated contract types the edit results; not before)
evidence: The engine sends reason (ios/engine/guarded-edit.ts:13-14 refuse) and Swift decodes it (EditOutcome.reason, now generated from contract.ts: ios/HealthRoadmap/Engine/Generated/EngineContract.swift:34, PR 1558), but RecordStore drops it building ApplyResult.refused (RecordStore.swift:14-18 has message and existingId only; :423 and RecordStore+Source.swift:181). Onboarding decides by state instead (PR 1570)
